evidence.finding: Local workspace chats support parallel streaming tabs, persisted attachments and terminal output; automations schedule unattended runs.

evidence.title: Sub-agents
evidence.finding: Atlarix-owned explore agents research in parallel. Build children propose per-file diffs for main-agent and human approval. Named children expose progress and hard stop.

evidence.title: Approvals
evidence.finding: Build edits require hunk approval unless allowed; ordinary commands run with per-OS write confinement and network on. Explore and Plan are read-only.

evidence.title: Headless CLI
evidence.finding: Node 20+ CLI runs on macOS/Linux/Windows with custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints and optional timeout; it auto-approves edits and commands subject to dangerous-command policy.

evidence.title: Codebase retrieval
evidence.finding: Uses on-demand glob and ripgrep, not embeddings or background repository indexing.

evidence.title: MCP servers
evidence.finding: MCP Registry and custom URL/command/config imports; remote servers sync to account and local endpoints remain per-computer/folder.

evidence.title: Pricing
evidence.finding: App features are free; BYO API/local models have no Atlarix fee. Pro $19 USD monthly includes $19 model usage; additional paid model credit starts at $10. Free Auto shares prompts with its providers, paid usage does not.

evidence.title: Changelog
evidence.finding: 2026-11-23 release describes rate-limit waits up to ten tries, early retired-model errors and stopped summary/reply handling.

evidence.title: Atlarix license

evidence.locator: Atlarix family; what this repo is
evidence.finding: Desktop macOS/Windows/Linux; CLI, VS Code-family extension and ACP clients. Core implementation is not published here.

evidence.title: Cloud task runner
evidence.locator: main; runAgent; push-token and PR creation
evidence.finding: Claims jobs with GitHub OIDC, runs CLI in checkout, streams progress, commits/pushes changes after exit, creates or updates PR, and reports completion or failure. No automatic merge or deployment call.

evidence.finding: CLI gets a 38-minute timeout and secret-filtered environment; progress derives from trajectory tool events, relic files join commits unless excluded, oversized files are omitted with a summary.

evidence.title: Read-only review runner
evidence.finding: Review binds checkout HEAD, serves only fixed Git reads, enforces output and command limits and a 14-minute overall cap; hosted service owns model findings.
